data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node 07c3398912d4 contradicts SRC_012's first-class attack-edge-node expansion: SRC_012 requires a global merge/identity rule to prevent double-counting when both the attacking argument and the attack-edge node are accepted, while the isolated node's case-relative commitment makes attack-edge identity depend on the diagnostic case, so no global identity rule can be stated without case parameters. Refuted if SRC_012's expanded AF can be instantiated with case-relative commitments without adding case parameters to attack-edge identity.
